title: Generalize NoteCanvas Surface to InkCanvas
description: Rename the framework SurfaceKind::NoteCanvas variant (wire "note-canvas") to SurfaceKind::InkCanvas (wire "ink-canvas"), and NoteCanvasScene -> InkCanvasScene, across ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, framework/core/js/index.ts, framework/renderer/react/ui-interpreter.tsx + its note-canvas-host.tsx (renamed to ink-canvas-host.tsx), framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs native renderer, and the owning note/plugin/rs/lib.rs call sites. Framework-purity fix: SurfaceKind must not encode app identity. Update the UiComponentSceneNode field noteCanvas -> inkCanvas to match convention. Define a generic ink-canvas action vocabulary (inkCanvasActions, modeled after nodeGraphActions/textEditorActions) replacing the note-specific "applyNoteEvents" action name the host dispatches. Inline test updates in framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts. Flag anything that can't be cleanly generalized (e.g. the rich text/table/math/group block schema mirrored from the note app's own document model) for later architecture audit. Part of a sequential wave of surface-generalization tickets under GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES (parent ticket not yet materialized at ticket_open time, per sibling ticket GENERALIZE-RASTER-SURFACE-KIND-TO-PAINT2D precedent).
